info.title: Bulk WHOIS Lookup API - Accurate and Efficient Mass Domain Queries
info.description: Retrieve the same real-time WHOIS registration and ownership data as the single-domain WHOIS Lookup API for up to 100 domain names in one request. The response is an object containing a `bulk_whois_response` array in request order; each entry is either a full WHOIS result (registrar, contacts, name servers, status codes, raw WHOIS text) or, if that specific domain's extension is unsupported or the lookup otherwise fails, an error object with `status: false` --- a bad domain in the batch does not fail the whole request. When the batch contains at least one such error alongside successful results, the endpoint returns `206 Partial Content` instead of `200`. Submitting more than 100 domain names returns a `413` error.

servers.description: Bulk Domain WHOIS Lookup API Server

post.summary: Retrieve real-time WHOIS registration and ownership data for up to 100 domain names in a single request
post.description: Returns the current WHOIS record for each requested domain, in request order. Supports up to 100 domain names per request; a domain that fails to resolve yields an error item instead of failing the whole batch.

200.description: WHOIS data retrieved successfully for every requested domain

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

BulkWhoisLookupRequest.description: Request body for bulk domain WHOIS lookup.

domainNames.description: List of domain names to retrieve WHOIS data for. A name sent more than once returns one entry but is charged each time it succeeds.

BulkWhoisLookupResponse.description: Wrapper object containing one WHOIS result or error per distinct domain requested. The entries are not guaranteed to follow the request order, so match each one to your list by domain_name.

bulk_whois_response.description: Array of per-domain results, one entry per requested domain. Each entry is either a full WHOIS result or, if that domain could not be resolved, an error object.

BulkWhoisLookupItemError.description: Per-item error, returned in place of a WHOIS result when an individual domain's extension is unsupported, the name is not a valid domain, or its lookup otherwise fails.

status.description: false when the extension is unsupported, true when the name is invalid. Test status_code, not status, to tell that an entry failed.

domain_name.description: Domain name that this error applies to.

status_code.description: HTTP-equivalent status code for this item's failure (e.g. 403 for an unsupported extension).

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable reason this domain could not be resolved.

DomainWhoisLookupResponse.description: Current WHOIS registration record for one successfully resolved domain.

status.description: true if this item was successfully processed.

query_time.description: Timestamp when the WHOIS query was executed.

whois_server.description: WHOIS or RDAP server that provided this record. Not returned for every lookup; registry_data carries its own whois_server.

domain_registered.description: Domain registration status; 'restricted' means the registry withholds registration details.

domain_handle.description: Registry handle of the domain, returned when the registry publishes one.

abuse_contact.description: Where to send abuse reports for the domain: the registrar's name, email and phone.

registrar_name.description: Name of the registrar the abuse contact belongs to.

eligibility_info.description: Eligibility record that some registries require for a registration, such as the trademark behind a name in an extension that asks for one.

id.description: Identifier of the eligibility record, such as a trademark number.

name.description: Name the eligibility record is held under.

type.description: Kind of eligibility, such as Trademark Owner.

create_date.description: Date the domain was originally registered, when the domain is registered.

update_date.description: Date the domain registration was last updated, when the domain is registered.

expiry_date.description: Date the domain registration is set to expire, when the domain is registered.

domain_registrar.description: Registrar of record for the domain.

reseller_contact.description: Reseller contact details, when the domain was registered through a reseller.

name_servers.description: Name servers currently recorded for the domain.

domain_status.description: EPP domain status codes currently recorded for the domain.

whois_raw_domain.description: Raw WHOIS text as returned by the registrar's WHOIS server.

DomainRegistrar.description: Registrar of record for a domain, as published by either the registrar or the registry.

status.description: Registrar's ICANN accreditation status (e.g. accredited), when published at the registrar level.

normalized_name.description: Lowercased, normalized form of the registrar name, when published at the registrar level.

whois_server.description: WHOIS server operated by the registrar, when published.

rdap_server.description: RDAP server URL operated by the registrar, when published at the registrar level.

email_address.description: Registrar abuse or contact email address, when published.

phone_number.description: Registrar contact phone number, when published.

handle.description: Registrar handle, returned when the registry publishes one.

registry_id.description: Registry identifier of the registrar, when published.

WhoisContactDetail.description: A contact record (registrant, administrative, technical, billing, or reseller) published in the domain's WHOIS record.

handle.description: Contact handle, returned when the registry publishes one.

id_type.description: Kind of identifier held in id, such as cnpj or Registry, when the registry publishes it.

email_address.description: Contact email address, or a privacy-service redirect instruction.

mailing_address.description: Full combined mailing address, when published as a single string.

DomainWhoisRegistryData.description: Registry-level (as opposed to registrar-level) WHOIS data, sourced directly from the TLD registry.

domain_name.description: Domain name as recorded by the registry.

query_time.description: Timestamp when the registry-level record was queried, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format — not ISO 8601 (no `T` separator, no milliseconds, no `Z`).

whois_server.description: Registry WHOIS server that returned this data.

domain_registered.description: Domain registration status as recorded by the registry.

create_date.description: Domain creation date as recorded by the registry.

update_date.description: Domain last-updated date as recorded by the registry.

expiry_date.description: Domain expiry date as recorded by the registry.

name_servers.description: Name servers as recorded by the registry.

domain_status.description: EPP domain status codes as recorded by the registry.

whois_raw_registery.description: Raw WHOIS text as returned directly by the registry server.

domain_registrar.description: Registrar of record as recorded directly by the registry.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
